description: List this account's private direct conversations, latest messages, and unread counts, newest first. Requires read scope. Messages are stored on the server and are not end-to-end encrypted. Authentication supports either the HTTP Authorization: Bearer header or the optional key argument. Clients may retain key arguments in task history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by a previous direct_conversations call for this account

key.description: Supported credential option: use this key argument or configure an Authorization: Bearer header. A client may retain arguments in history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

name: direct_conversations
